OBJECTIVE: - To leverage my knowledge and skills in the field of business analysis, research analysis, product development, solution architecture and implementation, presales consulting strategic management, value consulting across BFSI, Digital transformation, Finance transformation and Product implementation processes while working in intellectually stimulating environment
SUMMARY
Led stakeholder workshops with senior business leaders to define and map business capabilities aligned to strategic objectives and future-state vision.
Delivered large-scale banking, financial, digital transformation programs and product development and innovation across Retail LOS (CRM, Branch, Digital) and Payments, driving process optimization and performance improvement initiatives.
Crafted POC’s for Gen AI, Agentic AI and MCP (Model Context Protocol) across finance transformation processes.

Introduced solutions such as Enterprise Content Management (ECM) and identified emerging industry trends to enable forward-looking business strategies.

Implemented and migrated platforms including ERP like SAP, business suite like iBPS, and ServiceNow to streamline operations and enhance process efficiency.
Experienced in defining product requirements, user journeys, prototypes, BRDs/FSDs, customer experience enhancements, and platform capability models and key business matric.
Proven track record in driving product strategy, roadmap execution, customer journey transformation, and platform modernization initiatives for retail banking, lending, onboarding, payments, and risk platforms.

Translated business strategy into Current and Target Operating Models using Business and Enterprise Architecture frameworks.
